summary: GlobalFoundries filed a Form 6-K reporting second-quarter 2026 financial results via a press release. The release details revenue of $1.786 billion, gross margin of 28.3%, net income of $167 million, and diluted EPS of $0.30, along with recent business highlights including a CHIPS R&D LOI for $300 million, completed acquisitions, and a quarterly dividend increase. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation event, despite mention of acquisitions.
